verdict.rationale: Eqvista documents centralized "stakeholder access" and a setting to control "Shareholder Equity Value Visibility," which implies stakeholders can log in and see their holdings and value, at least in part. Nothing describes an employee-facing portal showing grants, vesting progress, or strike price. The waterfall and round-modeling tools are framed as leadership/admin features, not employee outcome modeling. missing for 10: explicit employee portal documentation, employee view of vesting progress, strike price display, employee-facing scenario/exit value modeling, independent or hands-on corroboration of the stakeholder experience.
